newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil opens Scandinavian methanol plan.
newsitem.headline: Statoil opens Scandinavian methanol plan.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) began production on Thursday at the world's sixth largest methanol plant at Tjeldbergodden, north of Kristiansund in mid-Norway, the NTB news agency said.
The 830,000 tonne per year plant, the first methanol facility in Scandinavia, began producing at 0200 GMT, two months behind the original schedule.
It will supply about 15 percent of Europe's requirements, NTB said.
"We are now producing at 60 percent of the unit's capacity and will increase (output) gradually," plant director Hugo Haldorsen told the news agency.
Gas from the Heidrun oilfield is piped to the plant for feedstock. It is the first time Norwegian gas has been used for industrial purposes, NTB said.
